topics.name: 🌊 Mission 1: Save the Dying Plant (Osmosis)
topics.short_description:
Ever wondered why your hands wrinkle when immersed in water?
Osmosis is involved.
In this chapter, you will explore osmosis.
topics.shorter_description: Explore why fingers wrinkle in water through osmosis.

Discover the magic of photosynthesis.
topics.shorter_description: Learn how plants turn sunlight into food.

topics.name: 🔥 Mission 3: Activate the Energy Core (Respiration)
topics.short_description:

Learn the secrets of cellular respiration.
topics.shorter_description: Understand how cells release energy from food.
